texts.facts: The petitioner, working as an Assistant Manager in the Kerala State Civil Supplies Corporation, filed this writ petition challenging Ext.P1 proceedings, by which he was transferred from Haripad Depot to the place of 4th respondent, who was transferred to Changanassery. Ext.P1 order involves the names of 7 Assistant Managers, who are posted in different Depots. The petitioner submits that neither the petitioner nor the 3rd and 4th respondents had applied for any transfer. The petitioner further submits that there are open vacancies of Assistant Managers in the Alappuzha District.
texts.arguments: 2. The learned Standing Counsel, Smt. Moly Jacob on instructions submitted that transfer is ordered on administrative grounds, in the back ground that Civil Supplies Corporation has been appointed as an authorised agency under the Food Safety and Standard Act.
